ambient_events: The forge breathes out, and the whole room goes orange for a second.
Somebody out on Foundry Way tests an edge on their thumb and swears.
A hand-lettered card by the grinder reads: NO, I WILL NOT SHARPEN THAT.
description: A long shed of a shop built around a forge that has not been allowed to go out in eleven years. Blades hang in racks by maker's mark — house work on the near wall, the good marques behind glass — and the floor is grey with a decade of grinding dust. It is twenty degrees warmer in here than outside, and everything smells of hot iron and quenching oil.
name: Grind House
